title: Doctoral Fellowships in Architecture and Technology
institution: ETH Zurich, Institute of Technology in Architecture (ITA)
about: Two full-time 3.5-year doctoral fellowships at ETH Zurich's Institute of Technology in Architecture, starting 1 October 2027. Candidates join one participating professorship. Applications via the online portal by 31 January 2027; notification by 1 April 2027.
requirements: University-level master's degree in architecture, engineering or a related field
Cover letter naming one preferred professorship, CV, portfolio and research statement

upskill.name: the course catalog
why: "University-level master's degree in architecture, engineering or a related field" → no course objective covers architecture or building technology (shortlist matched only the words "architecture"/"vision" in AI-model courses such as Computer Vision II), so the Academy catalog is linked instead of a course
